name: Dorm Till Dawn
source:
Welcome to St Fiacre’s College for Women of Unreliable Size. Your new home. If you can survive your first night…

You're entering a refuge for women afflicted by Xm-96, a disease that's caused a global pandemic of people shrinking or growing. Worse, when people change size, it causes dangerous responses and unnatural appetites.

This fully illustrated survival horror visual novel is set in one dorm with three roommates and plenty of tricky situations to navigate. Choose your responses carefully to avoid a terrible fate: should you shrink, it won't be easy to escape.

Beware Paige, who seems outwardly friendly, and Cass, who appears to be missing. But most of all beware Bayley, your furious roommate who's dangerous enough at regular size.

Here, you might easily get stepped on. But worse fates await if you get caught. Here, the big prey on the small...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4351680/]Steam[/url]]
